subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add one-way A2A dispatch semantics, and should that be a per-call `sessions_send` mode or a separate tool/primitive?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the permanent API affects core agent semantics, docs, tests, and compatibility with existing A2A conversation workflows.

options.title: Add per-call dispatch mode
options.body: Add an additive `sessions_send` mode that skips requester ping-pong and target announce unless explicitly requested, while leaving the current default unchanged.

options.title: Add a separate primitive
options.body: Introduce a new one-way delivery tool or primitive and keep `sessions_send` as the conversation-oriented API, accepting a larger public surface.

options.title: Defer to narrower guard fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as design context while landing reverse-call, cycle, and acknowledgement fixes separately without adding a dispatch mode yet.

recommendation.title: Add per-call dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Add an additive `sessions_send` mode that skips requester ping-pong and target announce unless explicitly requested, while leaving the current default unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history signal for the multi-agent/session tool product boundary and API-shape decision.
